main.description: A tile the account has installed in mu, so that it shows among its apps and runs on a page of its own. It is the tile that is installed, not a post that carries it. Deleting the record uninstalls the tile.

subject.description: The tile: its ing.dasl.masl record, with the repo as a DID, and the CID that record had when it was installed. The tile that runs is the record as it is now.
